notes: A decisive Jev strong judgment can promote a role without exact keyword overlap.
An existing weighted keyword High can proceed when Jev places at least 0.9 combined probability on strong or plausible alignment.
Strong versus plausible uncertainty is not the same as uncertainty about relevance. Deep assessment must verify actual evidence.
Only a decisive functional mismatch becomes Skip. Provider errors and missing descriptions remain Worth checking.
These are initial routing policies, not calibrated hiring probabilities.
